title: Caller corrects a misheard date of birth

transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hello, I need an appointment with Dr. Smith.
Certainly. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Aisha Karim. Born September fourteenth, eighty-nine.
I heard September fourteenth, nineteen eighty-nine. Is that right?
No, it's the fourth. September fourth.
Thanks for the correction: September fourth, nineteen eighty-nine. Are you a new or an existing patient?
What insurance provider do you have?
Dr. Smith can see you Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
Booked: Aisha Karim, Wednesday at 2 PM. A confirmation will be sent. Goodbye.
